note: Curated from official indices; property indices publish quarterly/monthly, not live. Refresh periodically from the sources below.

india.headline: 50-city index up ~5.7% YoY; 45 of 50 cities appreciating (Q1 FY26). Index 104.51 in Q1 2026 vs 102.32 prior quarter. Upward trajectory since Sep 2021; ~100bps home-loan rate cuts (Feb 2025) supporting demand.
india.guidance: Rental yields in Indian metros run ~2-3.5%, so price appreciation carries the return case. Buy to live (rent-vs-EMI math, ≤28-30% of income on EMI) rather than as a default investment; for investment exposure, SEBI-regulated REITs give commercial property yields of 6-8% without leverage or illiquidity.

ireland.headline: National RPPI +6.2% YoY (Apr 2026) — slowest since Feb 2024 but still rising. Mar 2026: +6.5% national; Dublin houses +5.1%, Dublin apartments +7.8%; outside Dublin houses +6.8%, apartments +12.0%. Hottest: Midlands +13.4%, Border +10.5%.
ireland.guidance: Supply shortage + population growth keep upward pressure; growth is decelerating, not reversing. First-time buyers: check Help-to-Buy and First Home Scheme eligibility; stress-test at +2% rates. Non-resident Indian buyers: factor 1-2% stamp duty, legal fees, and EUR/INR exposure.
